SPICEJET.verdict: C4 — FILLABLE, source has both inputs
SPICEJET.evidence: screener.in consolidated quarterly: Operating Profit populated in 13 of 13 shown quarters (Dec-2025 = -181) AND Depreciation populated in 13 of 13 (Dec-2025 = 146). Our schema's EBIT = OP - Depreciation, so it derives cleanly (-327). Our sf_revop holds op in only 4 of 22 quarters, so `op` is a gap here too.
SPICEJET.next: P3 fill via the revop ledger; verify one quarter against the filed PDF before trusting a derived series.

_insurers_op_present_dep_zero.evidence: screener.in shows Operating Profit populated in 13 of 13 quarters but Depreciation as literal 0 in every quarter. Under the IRDAI account format depreciation is not broken out of 'Operating Expenses related to Insurance Business'. A 0 here is therefore a NOT-DISCLOSED sentinel, not a measured zero (feedback-zero-is-a-no-base-sentinel / feedback-falsy-sentinel-needs-truthy-test). Deriving EBIT = OP - 0 = OP would silently assert 'this insurer has no depreciation', which no filing says.
_insurers_op_present_dep_zero.next: Read one actual filed result per name and establish whether the format discloses depreciation at all. If it does not, these are C1 (report-absent) exactly like the banks. If it does, C4.

_no_op_values_either.evidence: screener.in carries the 'Operating Profit' ROW LABEL for these (which is why they separate from the 33 banking-format names) but no non-zero values in the quarters shown. So the aggregator does not answer the question either way.

_p3_root_cause_ebit._finding: THE WHOLE ebit GAP IS EXPLAINED BY FILER FORMAT, and it is documented in our own XBRL extractor — scripts/build_revop.py metrics_for(). Found 2026-08-16 while walking the §57 route ladder. This supersedes the aggregator-based reasoning: build_revop reads the XBRL of the actual filings and branches on tags, so it is a statement about the filings, not about our coverage.

ebit_is_None_for_FOUR_formats.life_insurer_IRDAI_LI: detected by the NetPremiumIncome tag; returns ebit=None (build_revop.py:236). rev = NetPremiumIncome + IncomeFromInvestmentsNet + InvestmentIncome; op = ProfitLossBeforeTax - other income. e.g. HDFCLIFE, ICICIPRULI, SBILIFE, LICI.
ebit_is_None_for_FOUR_formats.general_insurer_IRDAI_GI: detected by the PremiumEarned tag; returns ebit=None (:250). rev = PremiumEarned + investments; op = rev - OperatingExpenses - NonOperatingExpense. e.g. ICICIGI, GODIGIT, STARHEALTH, NIACL.
ebit_is_None_for_FOUR_formats.bank: detected by InterestEarned + OperatingProfitBeforeProvisionAndContingencies; ':261 # ebit not reproduced for banks'. rev = InterestEarned, op = pre-provision profit.
ebit_is_None_for_FOUR_formats.nbfc_ind_as: detected by InterestEarned with NO bank op tag; ':276 # ebit not reproduced for NBFCs'. op = PBET + FC + Dep - OI - OtherRevenueFromOperations.

_p3_root_cause_ebit.ebit_is_computed_ONLY_for_industrial: ebit = ProfitBeforeExceptionalItemsAndTax + FinanceCosts - OtherIncome (build_revop.py:280), i.e. operating profit after depreciation. For a bank or NBFC FinanceCosts IS the core cost of the business, so the formula would not mean 'earnings before interest' — consistent with the user's option-A decision.
_p3_root_cause_ebit.why_this_is_better_evidence: It names the XBRL tags that distinguish the formats, and the rev/op values these branches produce are Trendlyne-exact per format (ICICIGI Q1FY27 rev 7088.22 / op 522.10; HDFCLIFE Q1FY27 con 33758.51). It is not an inference from our own gaps (§63).
_p3_root_cause_ebit.what_it_implies_for_the_remaining_1251_e: The 12 unresolved non-banking names are LI/GI insurers — same structural class as the banks. Many of the 94 'has-ebit-somewhere' names are NBFCs/financials (SHRIRAMFIN, SAMMAANCAP, 360ONE, POONAWALLA, BAJFINANCE, CHOLAFIN, MUTHOOTFIN, LICHSGFIN, PFC, RECLTD, HDFCAMC, SBICARD ...), whose ebit plausibly STOPS at an Ind-AS/NBFC format transition rather than being a hole.
_p3_root_cause_ebit.BLOCKED_ON: Per-name format determination needs the XBRL itself. There is NO local _xbrl_cache on this Mac (the path in scan_xbrl_nature.py is the old Windows one), so this is a fetch campaign, not a code change. Do NOT mark these N/A from the sf_revop pattern alone — that is exactly the circular inference §63 was written about.
_p3_root_cause_ebit.NEXT: Fetch XBRL per name for the 107 ebit-gap and 67 op-gap names, branch with build_revop's own metrics_for() detection, and record the format per name. Names that resolve to LI/GI/bank/NBFC become C1; industrial names with missing quarters become C4 fills. SPICEJET is already confirmed industrial and fillable.

_p3_nbfc_decision._decision: USER 2026-08-16: show NBFCs exactly as screener does — no EBIT, same as banks.
_p3_nbfc_decision._method: screener.in's OWN LAYOUT is the criterion, checked PER NAME across all 54 NSE-NBFC-flagged symbols. Screener replaces "Operating Profit"/"OPM %" with "Financing Profit"/"Financing Margin %" for a lender, exactly as it does for banks.
_p3_nbfc_decision.\u26a0\ufe0f_why_per_name_mattered: A "financials are lenders" category rule would have been WRONG on 23 of 58 names. screener treats asset managers (HDFCAMC, UTIAMC, NAM-INDIA, ABSLAMC, ICICIAMC), brokers/wealth (ANGELONE, MOTILALOFS, NUVAMA, 360ONE, JMFINANCIL), holding companies (BAJAJHLDNG, BAJAJFINSV, TATAINVEST, IDFC) and PIRAMALFIN/EDELWEISS/RELCAPITAL/DHANI as ORDINARY companies — fee businesses, not lenders — so they keep a real Operating Profit and keep EBIT. The NSE NBFC flag also mis-flagged WESTLIFE (McDonald's India), PAGEIND (Jockey) and RAJESHEXPO (jewellery); screener correctly calls all three ordinary.
_p3_nbfc_decision.DHFL: screener returns HTTP 404 (delisted/merged into PIRAMALFIN). Not adjudicated here; its 3 alias-shadowed ebit quarters remain a separate open item.
_p3_nbfc_decision.DATA_vs_PAGE_DIVERGENCE_KNOWN: This marks the COVERAGE PAGE N/A. The underlying sf_revop still holds ebit for ~795 lender quarters (784 of them produced by our own XBRL parse, not by aggregators — measured), so the backtest engine can still screen on them. Aligning the data means fixing build_revop.py's filer detection and rebuilding from the XBRL cache, which does not exist on this Mac. Recorded as an OPEN follow-up, not silently left.
